frozenSupport: Ultralearning is deep self-education for learning hard things in less time.
Ultralearning is the opposite of dabbling because it has commitment, protected time, and a concrete direction.
Ultralearning projects are hard enough that they should matter and compete seriously for time.
safeExtensions: A first project should be serious enough to justify the principles already learned.
Protected time and concrete scope matter because vague intention does not create a real project.
Seriousness should produce commitment and design rather than vague grandiosity.
